**220. “With those souls which enter, etc.” With those souls which enter that creature** [ ḥaya ]**,** Malkhut **, several flying creatures,** i. e., angels, **emerge.** [They] **fly and roam throughout the world. When a soul emerges to this world, that flying creature which flew and emerged with that soul, from that tree, emerges with it. How many angels emerge with each and every soul? Two: One on the right and one on the left. If he merits, they protect him, as it is stated: “For He will give His angels charge over you, to guard you”** [Psalms 91:11]. **And if not, they accuse him. Rabbi Pineḥas said: There are three** angels **that protect a person when he merits it, as it is stated: “If there is for him an angel, an intercessor, one out of a thousand, to vouch for a person’s uprightness”** [Job 33:23]. “If there is for him **an angel”** is one; **“an intercessor”** is two; **“one** out of a thousand, to vouch for a person’s uprightness” is three.

**221. “Rabbi Shimon said, etc.” Rabbi Shimon said: They are five angels, for it is further written: “Then he is gracious to him and says,** [deliver him from going down to the pit; I have found a ransom’’ Job 33:24]. **“Then he is gracious to him” is one; “and says” is a second,** which makes five [together with the three of the previous section]. [Rabbi Pineḥas] **replied: Not so; rather, “then he is gracious to him” is the Holy One, blessed be He, alone,** and not an angel, **for no other has the authority to pardon him except He** Himself. **He responded: You have spoken well.**

Explanation: Together with the souls, several angels are born and emerge, called **birds.** These angels support the souls in [their efforts toward] tilting [toward] the scale of merit, or [the angels] act in the opposite manner, when they accuse [the souls that sin] and push [those souls] toward the scale of detriment, as [the Zohar ] will proceed to explain. This is the meaning of the phrase: **“They fly and roam throughout the world,”** and they see God’s providence over all the inhabitants of the world, how they are watched over by Him. They convey this to the soul, and if the soul merits, it tilts itself and the entire world to the scale of merit. If [the soul] does not merit, it tilts itself and the entire world to the scale of detriment. This is why [the Zohar ] asked [in the previous section]: **“How many angels emerge with each and every soul?”**

Now, Rabbi Pineḥas does not disagree with Rabbi Shimon, who claimed that only **two birds** are born with the soul. Instead, [Rabbi Pineḥas] maintains that as long as he has only those **two birds,** he cannot tilt himself fully to the scale of merit, but is tossed back and forth from judgment to mercy and from mercy to judgment. However, through good deeds a third angel is born to him, and then he merits to tilt towards the scale of merit. This is why [the Zohar ] states that **“there are three** [angels that protect a person] **when he merits it”** [see previous section], for he can merit it only by means of three angels.

**222. “One who refrains, etc.” One who refrains from procreation diminishes, as it were, the form that includes all forms,** which is the human form, **and affects that river,** Yesod of Ze’er Anpin , **so that its waters do not flow, and impairs the holy covenant on all sides. With regard to him it is stated: “And they shall go forth and look upon the carcasses of the men who have rebelled against Me”** [Isaiah 66:24]. **Indeed “Me”;** T**his** is referring **to the body, whereas his soul does not enter the partition at all,** i. e., into the domain of the Holy One, blessed be He, **and he is banished from that world.**

Explanation: The Malkhut is called **“the form that includes all forms,”** because all the forms of nefesh , ruaḥ , and neshama of the righteous and the angels of the three worlds Beria , Yetzira , and Asiya are drawn forth through [the Malkhut ]. Those [beings] are the soldiers and armies [of the Malkhut ]. Therefore, one who does not engage in **procreation** diminishes the form of Malkhut and prevents it from bringing out all its soldiers and armies. [This is because it is through] an awakening from below [such as the act of reproduction] that there is a corresponding awakening from above, causing a coupling of the Holy One, blessed be He, and His Divine Presence, to beget nefesh , ruaḥ , and neshama and angels in Beria , Yetzira , and Asiya , as stated above.

This is the meaning of the statement: **“And affects that river such that its waters do not flow.”** [A person] causes Yesod of Ze’er Anpin to not transmit masculine waters to the Divine Presence. [The person] impairs the holy covenant in all of its aspects, [in that he] holds back the two types of fusion, one from the side of the six extremities and [one] from the side of the first three [ sefirot ]. **“With regard to him it is stated: ‘And they shall go forth and look upon the carcasses of the men who have rebelled against Me, ’”** since the [fulfilment of the] commandment of **procreation** [imparts a] constant expansion of his soul, by virtue of which he also triumphs over his body forever, so that it will stand at the resurrection of the dead. One who does not engage in **procreation** renders his body like **a carcass,** as it states regarding him: “And they shall go forth and look upon the carcasses etc.” His soul will be unable to enter the domain of the Holy One, blessed be He, and he is rebuffed from the World-to-Come.

**223. “The seventh commandment, etc.” The seventh commandment is to be circumcised at eight days and to remove the contamination of the foreskin. That creature** [ ḥaya ]**,** which is Malkhut , **is the eighth level of all levels,** i. e., [when counting] starting from Bina . **That soul which flies from** [ Malkhut ] **must show itself before** [ Malkhut ] **at eight days, for it is the eighth level.**

Explanation: The Nukba of Ze’er Anpin is called a **“creature”** [ ḥaya ] only through its ascent and enclothing of the Bina , which is the eighth level of the ten sefirot , [when counting] from below to above. The Malkhut , which is Nukba of Ze’er Anpin , is also called “eighth,” because it ascended eight levels, from [its own level] to the Bina . Only then is it also called a **“creature”** [ ḥaya ], like the Bina .

Now, the soul of man, which is born from the Nukba of Ze’er Anpin called a **“creature”** [ ḥaya ] and “eighth,” must show itself before the Nukba with the rectifications of circumcision and [the act of] uncovering [that precedes the circumcision], on the eighth day after [the soul’s] birth. [Through this] it is apparent and evident that the soul [comes] from that holy creature [ ḥaya ], and not from another side. [This is] because it is through the power of the circumcision and uncovering that the Sitra Aḥara is entirely rebuffed from **that** human **soul,** and [the soul] can receive the full lights of that creature [the Malkhut called ḥaya ]. **This is the meaning of “Let the waters swarm”** [see next section]. Through this, the [soul] receives the supernal masculine waters [flowing from] [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba and is completed through these waters.

**224. “At that time it is seen as a certainty, etc.” At that time it is visibly clear that it is a living creature** [ nefesh ḥaya ], i. e., **a soul** [ nefesh ] **of that holy creature** [ ḥaya ], which is Malkhut , **and not from the other side** [ Sitra Aḥara ]. **This is** [the meaning of]: **“Let the waters swarm”** [Genesis 1:20], which is explained [as follows] **in the Book of Enoch: The waters of the holy seed will be imprinted with the impression of the living creature. This is the imprint of the letter yod , which is inscribed in the holy flesh more than all the other inscriptions in the world.**

Explanation: [The Zohar ] interprets the verse: **“Let the waters swarm** [ yishretzu ] **with swarms of living creatures”** as a language of imprinting and inscription [ hitztaiyrut ]. Through the circumcision and [the act of] uncovering [prior to the circumcision], the supernal masculine waters which are transmitted to a person’s soul, are imprinted and inscribed in the **imprinting** and inscribing of the Nukba , which is called a **“living creature”** [ nefesh ḥaya ].

Now, the higher world, Bina , is inscribed and sealed with the [letter] ** yod ,** while the lower world, Malkhut , is inscribed and sealed with the [letter] ** heh .** When the Malkhut , which is the Nukba , ascends and enclothes the higher world, Bina , **the heh leaves and is replaced by a yod ,** like the Bina (as stated at the end of section #17#, above; see the Sulam there).

[The Zohar ] continues: **“This is the imprint of the letter yod , which is inscribed in the holy flesh more than all the other inscriptions in the world.”** Through circumcision and [the act of] uncovering [prior to the circumcision], all **the inscriptions of** this **world,** which are from the [letter] ** heh ,** are removed from man as well, and **the imprint of the letter yod ** comes in its stead, just as occurred in the Nukba which ascended to Bina , as stated. Since the holy flesh of Yesod is sealed with the ** yod ,** the man can also receive a complete living soul [ nefesh ḥaya ] from the **holy** Nukba .

**225. “And let fowl fly, etc.” “And let fowl fly above the earth”** [Genesis 1:20]. **This is Elijah, who flies the entire world in four flights, in order to be there at that covenant of the holy sign** of circumcision. **A seat must be set up for him, and one must declare with his mouth: “This is the seat of Elijah.” Otherwise, he will not be present there.**

Explanation: We must understand that here [the Zohar ] is interpreting the verse **“and let fowl fly”** as referring to **“Elijah, who flies the entire world in four flights,”** while later ( Bereshit I, page 314, section 407) [the Zohar ] will expound the ensuing verse, “and every winged fowl after its kind” [Genesis 1:21], in relation to the angels that fly and glide through the world in six flights.

The reason is that here [the Zohar ] is mainly interpreting the end of the verse, which states **“above the earth.”** This cannot be explained as referring to the lofty angels, for they are not in the earth [at all]. Therefore, it must necessarily be **Elijah,** as stated below, Bereshit II, page 107, section 166: **“Fly above the earth” is Elijah, who is always found in the earth, and not at the side of Abba and Imma ** [“Father and Mother”]**, since he flies in four flights.** The meaning is as follows: The angels are **from the side of Abba and Imma ,** and thus they are found only in heaven and they have six extremities: Ḥesed , Gevura , Tiferet , Netzaḥ , Hod , and Yesod . Consequently, when [those angels] come to the earth to fulfill their mission, they fly **in six flights,** for they are enclothed in six sefirot .

**Elijah,** however, is not **from the side of Abba and Imma ,** but from the side of Malkhut , and this is the mystical meaning of **“is always in the earth.”** Because the Malkhut has only four sefirot from Ze’er Anpin , i. e., Tiferet , Netzaḥ , Hod , and Yesod , from his chest and below, he therefore **flies the entire world in** only **four flights,** that is, he is enclothed in the four sefirot Tiferet , Netzaḥ , Hod , and Yesod . Since the verse states: **“And let fowl fly above the earth,”** it cannot be referring to the angels, but only to **Elijah,** who is on the earth. This is not the case for the verse: **“And every winged fowl after its kind,”** which does not mention “above the earth.” That is referring to the angels, who are **from the side of Abba and Imma , and they fly the entire world in six flights.**

**“In order to be there at that covenant of the holy sign** of circumcision.” Below ( Lekh Lekha , page 129, section 388) he states that the reason is because Elijah said: **“I have been very jealous for the Lord,** [the God of hosts], **for the children of Israel have forsaken Your covenant** etc.” [I Kings 19:10]. “[God therefore] **said to him: By your life; in every place where My sons inscribe this holy inscription in their flesh, you will be present there. The mouth that testified that Israel have forsaken** [the covenant] **will testify that Israel are fulfilling it. And we learned: Why was Elijah punished by the Holy One, blessed be He? Because he slandered His children.”**

Now, Heaven forbid that this should be understood in accordance with its plain meaning, that Elijah was sentenced to being present at every circumcision in Israel as a punishment for **slandering** [the people of] Israel. Furthermore, why is it stated here that he must be invited and **“one must declare with his mouth: ‘This is the seat of Elijah. ’ Otherwise, he will not be present there”?** If, Heaven forbid, he is forced be present at every circumcision as a punishment, then [clearly] he has to be **there.** In addition, why is **Elijah’s** testimony required, for him to attest before God that the children of Israel are observing circumcision? Is not everything revealed before God? Rather, a great and awesome secret is concealed here under [the Sages’] sweet words, as is their usual practice.

You can understand this matter by means of a passage cited in the Zohar ( Shelaḥ Lekha , page 39, section 117): **Rabbi Ilai opened** [his discourse] etc.: **With respect to Abraham it is stated: “Walk before me and be wholehearted** [ tamim ]” [Genesis 17:1], [whereas with regard to] **Jacob, who was more complete, it is stated: “Jacob was a whole** [ tam ] **man”** [Genesis 25:27]. **Why is he called “a tam man”? Because there was no waste left in him at all, for uncovering had transpired in him** etc. **The place of uncovering of the flesh is an ox, which is the form of the left of His throne. That ox is called an innocuous** [ tam ] **ox... for there is a forewarned** [ mu’ad ] **ox on the uncovered area of the foreskin. Several plaintiffs emerge from it until the lower level, called “destruction”... in the company of that forewarned ox** etc. **“And Jacob was a tam man” means the husband of that tam one.** See there.

Explanation: There are four kelippot : “A stormy wind”; “a great cloud” “a fire flashing”; and “a brightness surrounding it” [Ezekiel 1:4]. The first three are all impure kelippot , but the kelippa of the “brightness [ noga ]” is half good and half evil. When the three kelippot are attached to [this fourth kelippa ], it becomes entirely evil, but when it separates from [the other three kelippot ] and cleaves to holiness, [this fourth kelippa ] becomes entirely good. The place of these four kelippot is at the [lower] endpoint of the partzuf , which is at the endpoint of Yesod , where there are two skins, one atop the other. The first skin is called **“foreskin,”** and it incorporates the three impure kelippot : “A stormy wind”; “a great cloud,” and “a fire flashing.” The second skin is called the skin of **uncovering,** which is an embodiment of the noga kelippa , which is half good and half evil.

Now, Adam the first [man] was born circumcised, because the three impure kelippot had no purchase on him, and he had only the noga kelippa in him, which is the skin of **uncovering.** [That kelippa ] was also entirely good, since it was separated from the three impure kelippot and cleaved to the holiness. However, due to the sin of the Tree of Knowledge, through the seduction of the snake which is formed from the three impure kelippot , [Adam] pulled over himself the second skin, which is the **foreskin,** as the Sages stated ( Sanhedrin 38b): “Adam the first [man] drew his foreskin forward.”

This is the mystical meaning of the verse: **“And warning has been given to its owner, and he has not kept it in** [but it has killed a man or a woman], **the ox shall be stoned and its owner also shall be put to death”** [Exodus 21:29]. At the time when the foreskin sprang upon [Adam] and connected to his Yesod , [Adam’s] soul of [the level of] Atzilut immediately flew away from him and [Adam] fell to Asiya , and death was decreed upon him. This is the mystical meaning of the Zohar passage cited above: **“There is a forewarned ox on the uncovered area of the foreskin.”** Since [Adam] was warned not to eat from the Tree of Knowledge and he did not observe [that command] but ate, the foreskin sprang upon him, as stated. The two skins were defiled together, because the skin of **uncovering,** which is noga , was also defiled on account of its connection and attachment to the foreskin, which is [formed of] the three impure kelippot . However, there is a difference between [the two skins], because the skin of uncovering is called **“an innocuous ox,”** rather than **a forewarned** one, since it was in [a state of] complete holiness before the sin of the Tree of Knowledge. It was defiled only due to the foreskin that was attached to it.

Therefore, there are two special rectifications [in the procedure of circumcision]: Circumcision and uncovering. It is written regarding the **forewarned ox:** “The ox shall be stoned,” and likewise the foreskin must be removed and cut off from the holiness and thrown to the dust. In the case of the **innocuous ox,** by contrast, it is stated: **“They shall divide its price”** [Exodus 21:35]. Similarly, the skin of uncovering must be placed in holiness, connected to Yesod , but it must be halved and torn this way and that, for the brains are thereby exposed to the partzuf once again and holy flesh is revealed.

This is the meaning of the statement there: **“Uncovering is performed with this ox, and the contamination of the waste is completely removed.”** By halving the skin this way and that, around the Yesod , all the contamination that the skin of **uncovering** received from its previous connection to the **foreskin** is nullified and goes away, and the brains that departed because of the foreskin can be revealed once more.

However, this is still not sufficient to bring back all the brains that left Adam the first [man] on account of the sin of the Tree of Knowledge, for it is written, “And **its owner also shall be put to death,”** even though **the ox is stoned.** This is due to the great power of **the forewarned ox,** which is the mystical meaning of the accusing samael , by virtue of the verse: **“And warning has been given to its owner, and he has not kept it in.”**

In order to rectify this [insufficiency], **Elijah** took upon himself that same **slander** of the samael , and accused the children of Israel instead of the samael , as it is stated: **“For the children of Israel have forsaken Your covenant.”** He thereby closed the samael ’s mouth and the mission of samael was cancelled because **Elijah** had taken his mission upon himself. This gave [Elijah] the strength to become an advocate later, at the times when he sees that the children of Israel are keeping the covenant.

This is why it states (below, Lekh Lekha , page 129, section 388) that the reason why **Elijah** must be present at every circumcision is so that **“the mouth that testified that Israel have forsaken** [the covenant] **will testify that Israel are fulfilling it.”** Since [Elijah] took upon himself the [accusing] power of samael to accuse the children of Israel, by saying that Israel forsook the covenant (in the mystical meaning of the verse: **“And warning has been given to its owner, and he has not kept it in”**), for this reason he also has the power to testify that they are keeping the covenant. Then the power of the **forewarned ox** is completely removed, and all the brains that left on account of the **forewarned ox** can be revealed once again. Understand this well; it will be further clarified below.

This is the meaning of the statement: **“A seat must be set up for him.”** That is, apart from the seat of the sandak [godfather], on which the **circumcision and uncovering** are performed, an additional seat must be set up for **Elijah.** This requires explanation: Why isn’t a single seat enough for both of them? The idea is that the mystical meaning of a seat is that it is always the start of a rectification by which the upper [level] rests upon the lower [level]. As has already been explained above (in the previous section), the issue of the brains that are revealed through the circumcision and uncovering, and the issue of **Elijah**’s testimony about the fulfilment of the covenant, are two distinct matters: The amount of brains that are revealed by virtue of the **uncovering** are an expression of **the innocuous ox, when it is not known that the ox was wont to gore** [see Exodus 21:36]. This is the mystical meaning of the returning of noga to holiness by means of: **“They shall divide its price”;** see there.

The purpose of **Elijah**’s testimony is to remove the evil of the **forewarned ox,** which is the power of the three impure kelippot themselves, and to close their mouths so that they cannot accuse. Consequently, two seats are necessary. The first is the seat of God, which is the seat of the sandek . [This chair] is for imparting the brains through the circumcision and uncovering. The second one is for imparting the illumination of **Elijah,** who closes the mouth of the kelippot so they cannot accuse. This is **the seat of Elijah.**

**“One must declare with his mouth: This is the seat of Elijah. Otherwise, he will not be present there.”** This requires clarification. What is this great obligation to issue the declaration **“This is the seat of Elijah,”** to the extent that if one does not articulate it, then even if a seat has been prepared for [Elijah], he will not come? The idea is as stated in the Zohar ( Ki Tisa , page 15, section 46), on the verse: “Why are you here [ poh ] Elijah” [I Kings 19:9], that this is the mystical meaning of the mouth of Elijah, while the sign of the covenant is the mouth [ peh ] of God; see there. Thus, there is a difference between the sign of the covenant, which is the brains that are revealed through circumcision and uncovering, in the mystical meaning of the mouth of God, and the mouth of Elijah himself.

In order to understand this, one must delve deeper into the issue of closing the mouth of the **forewarned ox** so it does not accuse Israel after the return of the brains through circumcision and uncovering. Apart from the aforementioned testimony of **Elijah,** another special rectification is required, which is achieved by throwing the foreskin to the dust. As stated in the Zohar ( Pekudei , page 212, section 691): **“When a person is circumcised on the eighth day,** such that the day of **Shabbat has** already **passed over him,** which is the mystical meaning of ** Malkut ** in the brains of Abba and Imma , called **holy, that foreskin,** which **is cut and thrown outside, the  Sitra Aḥara  rises and sees** it, [and realizes] **that it has been given a part of that offering** of circumcision. By virtue of this gift, [the Sitra Aḥara ] **is then broken and is unable to rule over and accuse them, and it is transformed** from an accuser **into an advocate of Israel before the Holy One, blessed be He.”**

Explanation: It is the nature of spiritual beings to be incorporated in one another. Since the foreskin was once attached to Yesod , when it is cut off from Yesod it takes part of the holiness with it. When we throw the foreskin to the external forces, they thereby suckle some illumination from the brains that are revealed through circumcision and uncovering. For this reason, [those external forces] no longer wish to accuse Israel and shut down these brains, for they too would lose their share that they take from these brains. They therefore become advocates for Israel, in order to maintain the brains in them.

As a consequence, **Elijah** cannot tolerate this rectification, for although [the external forces] stop accusing Israel, they take part of the holiness in return. To rectify this, **Elijah** took all the accusing upon himself as he does not wish to appease [the external forces] at all by giving [them] a part of the offering of holiness. The result is that although the Sitra Aḥara has stopped accusing and become an advocate, **Elijah** himself is still accusing, in order to uproot the power of the Sitra Aḥara entirely and separate it from the holiness. Therefore, the mouth of **Elijah** is required here, in addition to **the mouth of God** which is revealed through the circumcision and uncovering and which leaves part of the offering to the Sitra Aḥara . **Elijah’s mouth** completely uproots the Sitra Aḥara , in the mystical meaning of: **“The mouth that testified that Israel have forsaken** [the covenant] **will testify that Israel are fulfilling it,”** as just stated above.

This is why **“one must declare with his mouth: This is the seat of Elijah.”** That is, it is necessary to mention and draw forth the aspect of **the mouth of Elijah** on his **seat.** [It is not sufficient to] make do with **the mouth of God,** which also removes the accuser and turns it into an advocate. [Relying only on the mouth of God] requires giving a part to the Sitra Aḥara , as stated. By means of Elijah’s mouth, however, the accuser is removed and he does not need to appease [the accuser] in return at all.

If a person does not make the effort to draw forth the **mouth of Elijah** with **his mouth,** upon his **seat,** then [Elijah] **will not be present there,** for he must be drawn in. One should not ask: “How is it possible for **the mouth of Elijah** to rectify more than **the mouth of God,”** for this is the mystical meaning of **“which God in creating had made”** [Genesis 2:3]: God initiated creation in such a way that man can complete it through his good deeds.

**226. “And God created, etc.” “And God created the great sea-monsters.”** “Sea-monsters” indicates **two,** and **these are the foreskin and uncovering,** i. e., **the cutting of the foreskin, followed by uncovering. And they are male and female. “And every living soul that creeps”: This is the imprint of the sign of the holy covenant, which is a holy living soul, as we have stated. “With which the waters swarmed”** [Genesis 1:21] **is the upper waters that were drawn to it, to this imprinted sign.**

Explanation: The **“sea-monsters”** are the leviathan and his mate. Corresponding to them are **the foreskin and uncovering,** which are “the slant serpent” and “the tortuous serpent” [Isaiah 27:1], male and female. T**he foreskin** is the slant serpent, a male, which must be removed and thrown to the dust, while uncovering is a rectification for removing the evil of the tortuous serpent, the female.

Now, the verse “and every living [soul, nefesh ḥaya ] that creeps” alludes to the imprint of the sign of the holy covenant. By means of the uncovering, when the skin of **the uncovering** is parted this way and that over the Yesod , the imprint of the [letter] ** yod ** appears, which is the aspect of the endpoint of the upper world called ** ḥaya ** (as stated above, in section #17#; see section #224#, above). This is why it is called **“an imprint of a holy living soul,”** regarding which the verse states: **“And every living soul that creeps.”**

[The Zohar ] continues: **“The upper waters that were drawn to it, to this imprinted sign,”** this is referring to the masculine **waters** [that flow downward from] the higher world, Abba and Imma Ila’in , which are called ** ḥaya .** They are drawn down only as [a result of] the imprint of the ** yod ** (as stated in section #17#, above). The [letter] ** heh ** emerges, and the ** yod ** enters [in its stead]; see there.

**227. “For this reason, Israel were imprinted, etc.” For this reason, Israel were imprinted with a holy and pure imprints below, like the holy imprints** above, **to distinguish between the holy side and the other side** [ Sitra Aḥara ]. **So is Israel imprinted, to distinguish between the sanctity** of Israel **and the idol-worshipping nations that come from the other side, as we learned. And just as He imprinted** Israel, **so too He imprinted their beasts and fowl, to** differentiate between them and **the beasts and fowls of the idol-worshipping nations. Happy is the portion of Israel.**

Explanation: Their beasts and fowl were also imprinted because a person’s relation toward the rest of the creatures in the world is like the relation of the collective toward its individuals. [This is] because man incorporates in his body all the creatures of the world in one collective [form]. Each and every creature is a single unit that exists independently, a [form] differentiated from the [collective] form of man [which collectively contains all those creatures]. Therefore, just as Israel are distinguished from the nations of the world in terms of their human aspect, that same distinction operates in the individualized [creatures], which are the [individualized forms of] **beasts and fowl.** [The Zohar ] singles out **beasts and fowl** because the verse mentions them, but the same applies to all creatures that are individualized [differentiations from the collective forms] of Israel and the [different collective forms of the humans of the] nations of the world.

**228. “The eighth commandment, etc.” The eighth commandment is to love the convert who comes to be circumcised and to enter under the wings of the Divine Presence. She,** the Malkhut , **brings under her wings all those who separate themselves from the impure other side** [ Sitra Aḥara ] **and draw near to her, as it is stated: “Let the earth bring forth the living creature** [ nefesh ḥaya ] **after its kind”** [Genesis 1:24].

Explanation: The topic of the wings of the Divine Presence is a lengthy and profound matter, but I will clarify it as much as necessary to understand this section. The Malkhut , which is the Nukba of Ze’er Anpin , is called **the Divine Presence** with respect to the [dynamic of] revelation. [The Malkhut ] does not depart from us even when we are very far from it, in the mystical meaning of: “**In every place where they were exiled, the Divine Presence is with them”** [see Megilla 29a], and in the mystical meaning of: **“That dwells** [ ha-shokhen ] **with them in the midst of their impurity”** [Leviticus 16:16; see Yoma 56b]. From this perspective, Ze’er Anpin is called ** Shokhen ,** and the Nukba [is called the] **Divine Presence**. This revelation [of the Divine Presence] occurs only when [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba are face-to-face at an equal height, since [in that state] the illumination of their pairing is very great, until the unification [of Ze’er Anpin and Nukba ] is revealed even in the most remote and restricted places.

It is known that the structure of maturity of [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba does not develop all at once. Rather, first the immaturity of [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba is constructed with the brains of the six extremities. After this [construction, the brains of] maturity are drawn forth. This [process] applies to all levels of [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba . Moreover, even when [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba have the brains of maturity, the brains of immaturity are not nullified, Heaven forbid, because they too must assist in the pairings [of Ze’er Anpin and Nukba when they are in the state] of the brains of maturity. At that stage, [the brains of immaturity are] called **“the wings of the Divine Presence.”**

This is the mystical meaning of the verse: **“And the cherubim shall spread out their wings on high, screening the ark-cover with their wings”** [Exodus 25:20]. The main function [of the wings of the Divine Presence] is to spread their wings and cover the illumination of the pairings [of Ze’er Anpin and Nukba when they are in the state] of maturity, such that even the most distant will be able to receive from the light of the pairing without anything thereby reaching the kelippot . Those who are not in a state of complete purity are always rebuffed by the light of holiness, out of fear that they might transfer the shefa to the kelippot . However, by means of the covering of the wings [of the Divine Presence], there is a great protection of the shefa , until even the ones nearest to the kelippot cannot fail and [thereby] bring down the shefa to the kelippot , because the wings protect [those distant entities].

Therefore, one who comes to convert and be circumcised, because his body derives from the aspect of the **foreskin** – for his ancestors did not stand at Mount Sinai and the contamination of the snake was not removed from them – nevertheless, we still have the power to raise him to supernal holiness. [This is achieved] by raising feminine waters for the pairing of [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba in the mature state of face-to-face. **The wings of the Divine Presence** rule there, spreading their wings and covering the light of that pairing, as stated. Then we can also raise the soul of the convert there, and he is sanctified by the light of that pairing.

Although [that convert] is not entirely pure, at that time he can receive from the illumination of the pairing, because the wings protect him so that the shefa [he receives] will not be transferred to the kelippot , Heaven forbid, despite the fact that he is near them. The reason why [the Zohar ] states “under the wings of the Divine Presence” is because [the converts] can receive only from the light of Malkhut , and only from the wings [of Malkhut ], i. e., the exterior of Malkhut . They cannot [receive] from **the body of the Divine Presence,** much less from Ze’er Anpin itself, as [the Zohar ] will proceed to explain.

[The Zohar continues]: **“She brings under her wings** etc.” One might question [this by noting] that [the Zohar ] previously stated **“and to enter under the wings of the Divine Presence,”** which implies that we must raise the convert [to be] under the wings of the Divine Presence. Here [however], [the Zohar ] says that **“she brings under her wings,”** implying that the Divine Presence herself raises the [converts] up [to be under her wings].

The explanation is that it is only possible to draw the soul of the convert closer at the time of a pairing [of Ze’er Anpin and Nukba in the state] of maturity. Only then do the wings of the Divine Presence cover the illumination [generated by] the pairing, as stated. Consequently, we must first raise feminine waters, to arouse this pairing of maturity and draw the illumination of the pairing to our souls. Then the Divine Presence spreads her wings and covers the light of the Divine Presence, bringing the soul of the convert under her wings. Thus, we first elevate the soul of the convert by means of our feminine waters, and after [that soul] has ascended the Divine Presence will receive him under her wings.

**229. “You might say that this, etc.” You might say that this nefesh ḥaya ** [living soul, creature]**, which is incorporated in Israel, is meant for everyone.** [The verse therefore] **reiterates: “After its kind”** [Genesis 1:24], i. e., **for Israel and not for the converts. How many corridors and rooms, one inside the other, are possessed by this Earth** called ** ḥaya ** [living], **under its wings.**

Explanation: It has been explained that it is possible to raise the soul of the convert only when we raise feminine waters for the pairing [of Ze’er Anpin and Nukba in their state] of maturity and draw for ourselves the illumination of neshama from that pairing. Then the spreading of the wings of the Divine Presence occurs, towards which the soul of the convert ascends, and he too receives from the light of the pairing, as stated.

In this regard, [the Zohar ] says: **“You might say that this nefesh ḥaya , which is incorporated in Israel, is meant for everyone.”** [In other words, ] one might claim that the convert also receives from that light of [the pairing of Ze’er Anpin and Nukba , the light of] the living soul [ nefesh ḥaya ] that Israel drew forth for the illumination of their souls. “[The verse therefore] **reiterates: After its kind,”** [to teach] that the converts receive [only the specific] illumination of the pairing that belongs to their type, i. e., only from the exterior of the pairing, not from the interior, which belongs to Israel alone.

Now, you already know that **the wings** are the aspect of the six extremities from the phase of immaturity, which function during the pairing of [the phase of] maturity as well, to cover the light [generated by] the pairing. The six extremities consist of Ḥesed , Gevura , Tiferet , Netzaḥ , Hod , and Yesod . Ḥesed , Gevura , and Tiferet are called **“rooms,”** meaning places for dwelling. Netzaḥ , Hod , and Yesod are called **“corridors,”** because they are only gateways and entrances to the rooms, but they themselves are not for dwelling, since they serve only as entrances and exits.

The reason [for this distinction] is that the essence of Ḥesed , Gevura , and Tiferet is Tiferet , their middle line, which is a complete vessel and a receptacle for the light of giving. [In contrast, ] the essence of Netzaḥ , Hod , and Yesod is Yesod , the middle line, which does not contain a receptacle for itself at all, but serves only as a passageway [for direct light], as well as to raise returning light, as is known. This is why the Netzaḥ , Hod , and Yesod are called only **“corridors.”**

[The Zohar ] says: **“How many corridors and rooms** etc. **under its wings,”** for she must bring under her wings converts from seventy nations, and therefore **many rooms** are ready for them in the Ḥesed , Gevura , and Tiferet of **the wings,** and **several corridors** in the Netzaḥ , Hod , and Yesod of **the wings.** [The converts] receive the aspect of nefesh from **the corridors,** and the aspect of ruaḥ from **the rooms.**

**230. “The right wing has, etc.” The right wing** of Malkhut **has two corridors, which divide from this wing for two other nations that are close to Israel in uniqueness, to bring them into these corridors. Under the left wing there are two other corridors, which divide for two other nations, Ammon and Moab. They are all called “living soul”** [ nefesh ḥaya ].

Explanation: [The Zohar ] previously stated that there are **several corridors,** whereas here it says that there are only two on **the right** and two on **the left.** The explanation is that here [the Zohar ] is speaking only about the encompassing [corridors], [i. e., ] that there are **two corridors** on the right, encompassing the nations that belong to the right, and there are **two** encompassing **corridors** on the left, for the nations that belong to the left.

[The Zohar ] says that there are **two nations** from the right side that incorporate all the nations from the right side, [nations which all] relate to the **two** encompassing **corridors** on **the right wing,** but the Zohar does not identify [those two main nations]. Likewise, there are two nations from the left side which incorporate all the nations from the left side. [Those two incorporating nations] are **Ammon and Moab.** These relate to the **two** encompassing **corridors** on **the left wing.**

[The Zohar ] says: **“They are all called living soul.”** All the souls of the converts that come from all the nations are called **“living soul.”** The reason is that they can receive only from the pairing of [ Ze’er Anpin and Nukba of the phase] of maturity since [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba are then in the place of Abba and Imma Ila’in . [In that state] the Malkhut is called **“living soul”** [ nefesh ḥaya ], because she contains the light of [ Abba and Imma Ila’in ], which is **the light of  ḥaya .** Since the souls of the converts receive from **the wings** of **the living soul,** they too are called **“living souls.”**

**231. “Several other closed rooms, etc.” Several other sealed rooms and other chambers are in each and every wing. Spirits emerge from them, to be distributed amongst all those converts who are converting. They are called “living souls,” but “after its kind.” They all enter under the wings of the Divine Presence, but no further.**

Explanation: Each wing is comprised of the six extremities, which are Ḥesed , Gevura , Tiferet , Netzaḥ , Hod , and Yesod . These are called **“rooms”** and **“corridors.”** Each and every nation has its own designated room in Ḥesed , Gevura , and Tiferet , and its own designated **corridor** in Netzaḥ , Hod , and Yesod . From the corridors each one receives an aspect of ** nefesh ,** and from **the rooms** each one receives an aspect of ruaḥ . The reason why [the Zohar calls them] **“sealed rooms”** is because Ḥesed , Gevura , and Tiferet of the six extremities are of the aspect of the covered [dynamic of] giving, which are **sealed** off from the illumination of Ḥokhma , as is known, and thus [the Zohar ] calls them “sealed.”

**232. “But the soul of Israel, etc.” But the soul of Israel emerges from the body of that tree,** Ze’er Anpin , **and from there souls fly into this earth,** Malkhut , **into its intestines, to the innermost place. The secret is: “For you shall be a delightful land”** [Malachi 3:12]. **Therefore, Israel is a darling son, for whom her innards yearn** [see Jeremiah 31:19]. **They are called “those who are borne from the belly”** [Isaiah 46:3], **and not from the wings,** which are **outside** the body. **Furthermore, converts have no portion in the supernal tree,** Ze’er Anpin , **and certainly not in its body. Rather, their share is in the wings** of Malkhut , **and no more. The convert is under the wings of the Divine Presence, and no more. Righteous converts are those who reside and have a hold there, but not inside, as stated. Because of this it is stated: “Let the earth bring forth the living creature** [ nefesh ḥaya ] **after its kind.” Regarding whom? “Cattle and creeping thing and beast of the earth after its kind”** [Genesis 1:24]. **All pull soul** [ nefesh ] **from that creature** [ ḥaya ], **but each after its kind, as befitting it.**

Explanation: Ze’er Anpin is called **“a tree,”** i. e., “the tree of life” [see Genesis 2:9], and Nukba is called “the land of the living” [see Job 28:13], that is, in the phase of maturity, when they enclothe Abba and Imma Ila’in , which are the brains of ḥaya . [The Zohar ] says: **“The soul of Israel emerges from the body of that tree,”** from the interior aspect of Ze’er Anpin , **“and from there souls fly into this earth, into its intestines, to the innermost place.”** By means of the pairing of **that tree,** which is Ze’er Anpin , **with the land** of the living, which is the Nukba , Ze’er Anpin transmits **the souls of Israel** to Nukba , to her innermost point within. From [that innermost point] **Israel** receive their souls from [ Nukba ], not like converts who receive only from the Nukba alone, and only from the exterior of the Nukba , from her wings, rather than from **“the innermost place,”** which means the innermost point within.

The idea is that the Nukba has three partzufim [reflecting phases of maturity] enclothed in one another, which are called gestation, infancy, [and] brains. The partzuf of the brains is enclothed in the partzuf of infancy, while the partzuf of infancy is enclothed in the partzuf of gestation. [The Zohar ] is precise [in saying] that **Israel** receives from the innermost point within the Nukba , i. e., from the partzuf of the brains.

This is the meaning of **“a darling son**...” [i. e., ] Israel is therefore called a darling son, for whom her innards yearn. They are called “those who are borne from the belly, and not from the wings,” which are her exterior. The explanation of this is that the Netzaḥ , Hod , and Yesod of the Nukba are called **“belly,”** because that is the place of the gestation and growth of the souls of Israel. However, it is not referring to aspects of Netzaḥ , Hod , and Yesod of the two external partzufim , called gestation and infancy, which are aspects of the wings. Rather, the reference is to Netzaḥ , Hod , and Yesod of the partzuf of the brains, which are of the aspect of the innards.

This is the mystical meaning of the verse: **“Is Ephraim a darling son to Me? Is he a child who is dandled? For as often as I speak of him, I earnestly remember him still; therefore My innards yearn for him,** etc.” [Jeremiah 31:19]. Since the souls of Israel are from the interior of Malkhut , called “the innards,” it therefore states: **“My innards yearn for him.”** This is why the verse calls them: **“Borne from the belly,”** for they are all of the aspect of Netzaḥ , Hod , and Yesod of the partzuf of the brains, **“and not from the wings,** which are **outside** the body,” [i. e., ] not from Netzaḥ , Hod , and Yesod of the two outer partzufim , which are an aspect of the wings.

[The Zohar ] continues: **“Furthermore, converts have no** etc.” [In other words, ] converts have no share in the supernal tree, and certainly not in its body. Rather, their portion is only in the wings and no more, meaning that which is under the wings of the Divine Presence and no further. This is why they are called “righteous converts,” because the Divine Presence is called righteous. They reside under her wings, and they unite with her, and they have no portion from above, from the Divine Presence.

[The Zohar ] continues: **“Regarding whom? Cattle and creeping thing and beast of the earth** etc.” Any [being] that has a soul from the aspect of **cattle and creeping thing and beast of the earth** receives [that soul] only from **the soul** [ nefesh ] **of that creature** [ ḥaya ], which is Malkhut in [a state of pairing in the phase] of maturity face-to-face with Ze’er Anpin . And yet **each is after its kind, as befitting it,** i. e., only from the aspect of **the wings** and not from the interior of the illumination of this great pairing.

**233. “The ninth commandment, etc.” The ninth commandment is to be gracious to the poor and give them food, as it is stated: “Let us make man in our image, after our likeness”** [Genesis 1:26]. **“Let us make man”** [means] **in partnership,** for he **consists of male and female. “In our image”** means [the] **wealthy; “after our likeness”** is referring to **the poor.**

**234. “For on the side of the male, etc.” On the side of the male** they are **the wealthy, whereas on the side of the female** they are **the poor. Just as they are in one partnership, have mercy upon one another, give to one another and perform kindness with him, so too must a person be below: The rich and the poor in one partnership, giving to each other, and performing kindness with one another.**

**235. “And let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, etc.” “And let them have dominion over the fish of the sea”** [Genesis 1:26]. **We have seen this secret in the book of King Solomon, that whoever has mercy upon the poor with a willing heart, his form never changes from the form of Adam the first** [man]. **Once the form of Adam is imprinted upon him, he rules over all the creatures of the world through that form. This is** [the meaning of] **the verse: “And the fear of you and the dread of you shall be upon every beast of the earth** etc.” [Genesis 9:2]. **They all tremble and are scared of that form which was imprinted upon him. Since this commandment,** to be gracious to the poor, **is a finer commandment than all other commandments for elevating man in the form of Adam the first** [man].

**236. “From where do we know this? From Nebuchadnezzar, etc.” From where do we know this? From Nebuchadnezzar. Even though he dreamed that dream, as long as he was gracious towards the poor, the dream was not fulfilled for him. Once he cast an evil eye to not be gracious towards the poor, what is written? “While the word was in the king’s mouth** [there fell a voice from heaven…And you shall be driven from men and your dwelling shall be with the beasts of the field,” Daniel 4:28-29]. **Immediately, his form changed and he was driven from men. For this reason** it is stated: **“Let us make man”** [Genesis 1:26]. **Here it is written “making,” and there it is stated: “The man’s name with whom I made today is Boaz”** [Ruth 2:19], where “making” means charity. Here too, “making” means charity.

Explanation: This requires explanation. While Scripture delineates the creation of **male and female,** i. e., **the wealthy and the poor,** there is no hint here at all that **the wealthy** should have mercy upon **the poor** and sustain them, which [would justify] his saying that this verse is **a commandment to be gracious to the poor** etc. [section #233#]. Rather, there is a very great profundity here, for this utterance differs from all the previous ones. In all of them the utterance is separate from the [action of] making, e. g., **“And God said, Let there be light. And there was light”** [Genesis 1:3]; **“And God said: Let there be a firmament**... **And God made the firmament”** [Genesis 1:6–7]; **“And God said: Let the waters be gathered**… **And it was so”** [Genesis 1:9].

The same applies to all of them; you will not find that the making is mixed with the utterance. The reason (as the Zohar explains below) is that creation emerged in the mystical meaning of Abba and Imma (father and mother), with Abba speaking and Imma making. Abba transmitted the shefa to Imma , and after the shefa was imprinted with the boundaries of Imma , the shefa was actualized. This resembles potential and actualization, since from the aspect of Abba alone no creation could be actualized, because there is no boundary [in Abba ] to define the actualization in any form, as is known. Therefore, there is an utterance from Abba , which is the mystical meaning of the transmission [of shefa ] to Imma . Since [the entity referenced in the utterance] is still in a state of **potential,** [the text] cannot use an expression of **making,** but rather [a language of utterance like]: **“Let there be.”** However, in the utterance of the creation of man, the phrase **“making”** is written in the utterance itself, as it is stated: **“And God said: Let us make man”** [Genesis 1:26]. There is another significant change here, for it is written, **“Let us make,”** in the plural, and not **“I will make man.”**

The idea is that before the creation of the world of tikkun (rectification), the breaking of the vessels occurred in the lower seven [ sefirot ] of the world of Nekudim , as the Sages, of blessed memory, taught: “He created worlds and destroyed them, until He created this world and said: This one gives Me pleasure” ( Bereshit Rabba 3:7). Now, by means of the breaking of the vessels in the seven sefirot : Ḥesed , Gevura , Tiferet , Netzaḥ , Hod , Yesod , and Malkhut of Nekudim , the holiness mingled with the kelippot . Subsequently, the name ** Ma ** was revealed and produced the four worlds Atzilut , Beria , Yetzira , and Asiya , on the path of rectification. This is the mystical meaning of His statement: “This one gives Me pleasure,” because [this process] distilled the holy sparks from the kelippot , and the worlds and everything in them were created in accordance with the distillation of the holiness.

This is the mystical meaning of the separation and distillation that can be found in every act of creation, such as “And God divided the light from the darkness” [Genesis 1:4], and “[Let it divide] the waters from the waters” [Genesis 1:6], and similarly [the division] between water and land [see Genesis 1:9–10], and the [phrase] “after its kind” stated in [the verse]: “Let the land put forth grass etc.” [Genesis 1:11], and “Between the ruling of the day and the ruling of the night” [see Genesis 1:16–18], as well as the emergence of living creatures from the water and from the earth.

All of this reflects the concept of distillation of the holiness from the kelippot , and the good from the evil. Anything that is distilled becomes an existing reality, as is appropriate for it in holiness. This is the mystical meaning of [the statement that] the entire act of creation is incorporated in the first day, in the utterance of **“Let there be light.”** It is there that the complete separation between the light and the darkness took place and in general terms, holiness is called **“light”** and the kelippot **“darkness,”** since all the other labels of holiness and kelippot are nothing more than particulars and branches of **light** and **darkness.**

Now, from the perspective of this distinction between light and darkness, by which all the creations in Genesis were distilled, the rectification is still incomplete. [The reason is] that from this perspective all the evil and the darkness remained as something for which there was no need, and that is completely incompatible with God’s wholeness. The rectification is completed only through the mystical meaning of the verse: “Even the darkness is not too dark for You…the darkness is like the light” [Psalms 139:12]. In order to rectify this, **man** was created, who incorporates everything, from absolute evil to absolute good. Through him, the completion of the rectification will occur in the desired fullness, i. e., the evil will be transformed into good, bitter into sweetness, darkness will be like light, He will eliminate death forever [Isaiah 25:8], and the Lord shall be king over all the earth [Zechariah 14:9].

Therefore, this utterance of the creation of man came out significantly different from the other utterances involving the rest of the creations of Genesis, as here the making is mingled with the utterance itself. The reason [for this difference] is that this utterance is from Imma rather than Abba . She said: **“Let us make man,”** which is language of partnership, because [ Imma ] partnered with Malkhut of Atzilut to create man. That is, Malkhut of Atzilut incorporates everything, in the mystical meaning of the verse: “And His kingdom rules over all” [Psalms 103:19]. [This Malkhut ] sustains and grants existence to the evil forces as well, since otherwise the evil would have no power to exist. This is the mystical meaning of: “Her feet go down to death” [Proverbs 5:5], for the kelippot receive from [this Malkhut ] a thin luminescence, enough for their existence. This is the mystical meaning of [the fact] that Malkhut is called Asiya [making; action], since she spreads out and rules over the whole of Asiya . [The Malkhut ] is also called “darkness,” because she illuminates a thin luminescence to sustain the darkness and the evil, as stated.

You can now understand that when Imma herself was incorporated in Malkhut in a unified partnership, the aspect of making and darkness became mingled in [ Imma ] herself. This is the mystical meaning of: **“Let us make man in our image, after our likeness.”** The **light** is called an **“image,”** while the **darkness** is called a **“likeness”** (as the Zohar states below). Once Imma partnered with Malkhut , the two forces, **image and likeness,** were made in [ Imma ] herself. Based on them, [ Imma ] created man such that he would also incorporate the two forces of image and likeness. This is why she said: **“In our image, after our likeness.”** Now that you know all this, the next parts of the Zohar will be clearly understood.

This is the meaning of: **“Let us make man, in partnership.”** In other words, the phrase “let us make” implies a partnership. “For he **consists of male and female,”** indicates that Imma herself is comprised of male and female. Although Imma is an aspect of the male world and she has no aspect of Nukba [the female] at all, she now partnered with the Malkhut , which is Nukba , as stated. **“‘In our image’** means [the] **wealthy; ‘after our likeness’** is referring to **the poor. For on the side of the male** they are **the wealthy, whereas on the side of the female** they are **the poor”** [sections #233#–#234#], because the male is the mystical meaning of light and wealth, while the female is the mystical meaning of darkness and poverty.

Since [ Imma ] said, “In our image, after our likeness,” [it can be seen that] darkness and poverty are found in [ Imma ] herself, on account of her partnership with Malkhut for the purpose of creation of man. Thus, man emerged as comprised of **the wealthy and the poor,** i. e., light and darkness. The entire rectification will thereby be completed through him, and the Malkhut will spread in her holiness over the whole earth, **and the Lord will be one, and His name one** [see Zechariah 14:9]. Then the darkness in Malkhut will be transformed into complete light, like the male, which is Havaya , and He will be one and His name one. Then the [promise]: **“However, there will be no needy among you”** [Deuteronomy 15:4] will be fulfilled.

Thus [the Zohar ] says: **“Just as they are in one partnership, have mercy upon one another, give to one another and perform kindness with him, so too must a person be below: The rich and the poor in one partnership, giving to each other, and performing kindness with one another”** [section #234#]. The image and likeness that are incorporated in Imma are in **one partnership,** because Imma has compassion upon the likeness, Malkhut , in order to rectify the entire aspect of darkness in [ Malkhut ]. The supernal Imma diminished herself and gave from her share to the Malkhut , which is poor, and **performed kindness with her.** Similarly, man, who was created by [ Imma ] in an image and likeness, must have mercy upon **the poor,** which are the aspect of likeness within [man]. [Man is meant] to be in one bond with them, provide for them all that they lack, and perform kindness with them. By fulfilling this commandment, he will draw upon himself the image and likeness of Imma with which he was created. This is the mystical meaning of all the supernal brains that Adam the first [man] was awarded when he was created with that image and likeness.

Then: **“And let them have dominion over the fish of the sea”... “that whoever has mercy upon the poor with a willing heart, his form never changes from the form of Adam the first** [man]. **Since the form of Adam is imprinted upon him, he rules over all the creatures of the world through that form”** [section #235#]. By virtue of this commandment [the person] merits that image and likeness of Adam, i. e., all those brains and supernal brightness of Atzilut with which Adam the first [man] was rewarded, by whose power he ruled **over all the creatures of the world,** meaning that there was no power of the powers of the evil that did not submit to him: **“They all tremble and are scared of that form,** that image, **which was imprinted upon him.”** He nullified all the forces of evil and darkness, and they could not stand before him at all, since the name of the Lord was called upon him, which is the mystical meaning of **the image of God,** as stated.

[The Zohar ] then cites a proof **“from Nebuchadnezzar,”** who did not have any commandments [accomplished], and yet after the decree was imposed upon him, in the dream and Daniel’s interpretation, Daniel instructed him: **“Break off your sins by almsgiving”** [Daniel 4:24], and he did so. **“As long as he was gracious towards the poor the dream was not fulfilled for him. Once he cast an evil eye, to not be gracious towards the poor, what is written? ‘While the word was in the king’s mouth** etc. ’ **Immediately, his form changed and he was driven from men.”** Thus, this commandment is greater than all the [other] commandments in the Torah, for by itself it can nullify from a person all sorts of evil decrees that have been decreed upon him.

[Thus the Zohar ] states (in section #236#): **“Here it is written making,”** deriving a verbal analogy: Just as [the phrase] “I made” with respect to Boaz refers to charity, so too the [phrase] “let us make” here means charity. That is, the language of **“let us make,”** which is stated regarding the creation of man, indicates the commandment of charity, because Imma performed charity with Malkhut and was incorporated in her, as stated. [The Zohar ] brings a proof from **Ruth,** who said: **“The man’s name with whom I made.”** This statement apparently defies explanation, since what does it mean that “she made with him,” seeing that she merely received from him? However, in light of the above explanation that “making” refers to the bonding of **the wealthy and the poor,** the term “making” in the case of **Boaz** is justified, since they partnered together in a single bonding through the [act of] charity.

**237. “The tenth commandment, etc.” The tenth commandment is to don tefillin and to complete oneself in the supernal form, as it is stated: “And God created man in His own image”** [Genesis 1:27]. **He opened** [his discourse] **and said: “Your head upon you is like Carmel”** [Song of Songs 7:6]. **We established** [the meaning of] **this verse, and it was taught: But “Your head upon you is like Carmel,” this is the supernal head, the tefillin of the head, of the supernal, holy ‎King, Havaya , with inscribed letters. Each letter** in the name Havaya **is one chapter** in the ‎ tefillin . In this way, **the holy name is inscribed** in the chapters of the tefillin , **in the order of the ‎letters, as is fitting. And we learned: “That the name of the Lord is called upon you and they will be afraid of you”** [Deuteronomy 28:10] – **these are the tefillin of the head** [ Berakhot 57a], **which are ‎the holy name, in the order of the letters. ‎**

Explanation: The aforementioned **commandment to be gracious towards the poor** was only the beginning [step] for drawing forth **the ‎supernal form,** which is the mystical meaning of **the image of God.** This is as stated above, that by means of the commandment to be gracious towards the poor, Imma (mother) was ‎incorporated in Malkhut , in the mystical meaning of: **“Let us make man in our image, after our likeness”** [Genesis 1:26]. Know that this is ‎the mystical meaning of **“the mother** [ Imma ] **lends her garments to the daughter”** (section #17#, above): Through the incorporation of Malkhut ‎in Imma , the letters ** alef - lamed-heh ** [ eleh ] fell to the place of [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba and only the letters ** mem-yod ** [ mi ] remained in Imma . It is ‎discerned that the letters ** alef - lamed-heh ** of Abba and Imma descended to the aspect of [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba , namely, the aspect of Abba [in those descending letters] took on the aspect of Ze’er Anpin , and the aspect of Imma took on the aspect of Nukba , ‎and the [letters] truly became of the aspect of [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba , because an upper [level] that descends to a lower [level] becomes like [that lower level]. ‎

Through [the descending aspects], [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba attained the aspect of immaturity of **the image** [ tzelem, spelled tzadi-lamed-heh ] **of God,** namely, six extremities without a ‎head, because the Imma herself also lost the aspect of her first three [ sefirot ] through this partnership [with Malkhut ]. The three vessels ** alef - lamed-heh ,** which are Bina , Ze’er Anpin , and Malkhut from her ten sefirot , ‎fell from her, leaving in Imma only the letters ** mem-yod ** [ Mi ], which are Keter and Ḥokhma of her ten sefirot . As is known, when the three lower vessels are missing, ‎the first three of the lights are missing, and [thus] only the lights of ruaḥ [and] nefesh remained in her vessels of ** Mi **: The ‎light of ruaḥ in the vessel of Keter , and the light of nefesh in the vessel of Ḥokhma . ‎

Consequently, [the Imma ] could only give [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba [the aspect of] six extremities without a ‎head. Given this, the [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba were not yet completed in **the lofty form,** which are the brains of the first three [ sefirot ], called **the image of God.** ‎This is the meaning of: **“To don tefillin and to complete oneself in the lofty form,”** that by means of **the commandment of tefillin ** the first three [ sefirot ] are drawn to [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba , [and those sefirot ] are the ‎completion of the lofty image. ‎

You might raise the following difficulty: Since this referring to the lower man, the [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba must have been completed already, since they would not be able to produce nefesh , ruaḥ , and neshama for the lower man before they themselves had ascended to the place ‎of Abba and Imma and matured in their brains like Abba and Imma. If so, why do we say that even Imma is still in [a state of] ‎immaturity [given that Abba and Imma possess mature brains]?‎

You should know that when the [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba attain the brains of Abba and Imma , they enclothe Abba and Imma and they are ‎properly like [ Abba and Imma , since a lower entity that ascends to [the level] of a higher one becomes truly like [that higher] one. Therefore, everything we now discern [and discuss in Abba and Imma is intended to [refer to Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba that [have now] become Abba and Imma All the pathways that are operative in Abba and Imma to ‎produce brains of [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba of Atzilut operate in precisely the same manner in [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba that became Abba and Imma. They ‎produce the brains, which are the nefesh , ruaḥ , and neshama , for the lower man, without any difference whatsoever [from Abba and Imma ] Accordingly, there ‎is no need to change the names at all, and we now call [ Ze’er Anpin and Nukba with the names of Abba and Imma , while the nefesh , ruaḥ , and neshama of the lower ‎man are named Ze’er Anpin and Nukba . Remember this below, for all of what comes later. ‎

[The Zohar ] continues: **“As it is stated: And God created man in His own image.”** The mystical meaning of ** tzelem ** [image] is a very complex matter, but I will explain it here only as much as necessary to understand the matter at hand. You need to have in mind all that was explained earlier in Marot HaSulam (sections #2#–#4#) regarding the number thirteen as it applies to the sefirot ; see there carefully, for ideas should not be repeated without good reason.

You will see there that yeḥida [and] ḥaya have no vessels. Only nefesh , ruaḥ , and neshama have the ‎vessels Bina and [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba . Even when we explicitly state “vessel of Keter ,” the reference is to Bina and [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba of Keter . Now, the Bina and [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba are divided into ten sefirot through the rectification of lines: ‎The three lines of Bina are Ḥokhma , Bina , and Da’at ; [the three lines] of Ze’er Anpin are Ḥesed , Gevura , and Tiferet ; and [the three lines] of Nukba ‎are Netzaḥ , Hod , Yesod , and Malkhut . This number applies to the light of giving. However, with regards to the transmitting of the illumination of ‎ Ḥokhma , Bina divides into two [ partzufim ]: [ Abba and Imma Ila’in ] and Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , which [together] are ‎ Ḥokhma , Bina , and Da’at ; Ḥesed , Gevura , and Tiferet . Together with the lower seven [ sefirot ] ‎of [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba , these make thirteen sefirot . This is the mystical meaning of the numerical value of ** eḥad ** [“one,” the letters alef-ḥet-dalet ], ‎which alludes to the full name. ‎

The root of the matter is that Keter and ‎ Ḥokhma were sealed off in the sealed ‎ Ḥokhma of ‎ Arikh Anpin , and only the Bina [of Arikh Anpin ] illuminates ‎all the brains of Atzilut , dividing into [ Abba and Imma Ila’in ] and Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna of Atzilut . The first three [ sefirot of Bina ] illuminate in [ Abba and Imma Ila’in ], and the six extremities [of Bina illuminate] in Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna . These two aspects of the Bina are termed [the letters] ** mem ** and ** lamed ** of ** tzelem .** [ Abba and Imma Ila’in ] are called ** mem ** in the mystical meaning of “a pure ring,” because the ‎** mem ** [that appears at the end of a word] is [shaped] like a closed ring, enclosing the brains all around. Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna are called [the letter] ** lamed ** of ** tzelem ,** because the ** lamed ** raises her head up high, like a tower. This head alludes to the brains of ‎the first three [ sefirot ], and this is the mystical meaning of the verse: “The name of the Lord is a strong tower; the righteous runs in it and is set ‎up on high” [Proverbs 18:10]. Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna is the mystical meaning of a tower, and Ze’er Anpin is called the righteous who runs in that ‎tower and is set up very high. ‎

[ Abba and Imma Ila’in ] are the mystical meaning of a ring that encloses the brains. The light of ‎ Ḥokhma will not be revealed in them, due to their great height, because the light of ‎ Ḥokhma in them is of the aspect of the sealed ‎ Ḥokhma itself, which disappeared from all the ‎ partzufim of ‎ Atzilut . Consequently, [the light of ‎ Ḥokhma ] is not revealed in [ Abba and Imma Ila’in ], and they contain only the light of giving, which is called “pure air,” since air is the mystical meaning the light ‎of ruaḥ . It is also called “sealed air,” because the [letter] ** yod ** never departed from their air [ avir ]. ‎

However, Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , as they are only the aspect of the lower seven [ sefirot ] of Bina , which is the mystical meaning of the [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba that are incorporated in Bina , are not called ‎‎“sealed air.” During the phase of the transmission of the brains of maturity to [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba , the ** yod ** departs from their ‎ avir [air] and they become or [light], meaning ‎ Ḥokhma and brains of the first three [ sefirot ]. For this reason, ‎ Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna is called “a tower [ migdal ] that flies in the air [ avir ].” Migdal means maturity [ gadlut ] of ‎ the first three [ sefirot ]. Because these brains are not permanently fixed in [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba , it follows that the phase of immaturity within [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba is the result of ‎the ** yod ** entering the or [light] and making it into avir [air]. In the phase of maturity, the ** yod ** reverts and exits from the avir , which then becomes or . [ Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna ] is therefore regarded as a flying tower, on account of the ‎rectification within it, in the mystical meaning of avir . [Lastly, ] the Ze’er Anpin is called [the letter] ** tzadi ** of ** tzelem ,** because it is the ‎righteous [ tzadik ] who runs in the tower that is set up on high, as stated.

We have thus thoroughly explained the three letters of ** tzelem ,** in the mystical meaning that Ze’er Anpin is ** tzadi **; Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna are ** lamed **; and [ Abba and Imma Ila’in ] ‎are ** mem .** ‎They are also the mystical meaning of ‎ Ḥokhma , Bina , and Da’at : [ Abba and Imma Ila’in ] ‎are ‎ Ḥokhma , enclosed in a pure ring, since they are of the aspect of the sealed‎ Ḥokhma [of Arikh Anpin ]. Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna are ‎ Bina , but when [ Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna ] ascends to the head of Arikh Anpin , the ** yod ** comes out of the avir and gives Ḥokhma , in the mystical meaning of ‎a tower that flies in the air. Ze’er Anpin is that which runs in that tower, namely, he receives those brains, and is the mystical meaning of Da’at . Remember all of this well, for these ideas are at the roots of Ḥokhma , and no change will ever transpire in these paths, which is why the ‎brains are always called by the name ** tzelem .**

When we said that ‎ Ḥokhma , Bina , and Da’at are the three letters ** mem , lamed ,** [and] ** tzadi ** of ** tzelem ,** they must not be confused ‎with the three lines in the ‎brains, which are [also] called ‎ Ḥokhma , Bina , and Da’at . The ‎ Ḥokhma , Bina , and Da’at of ** tzelem ** ‎are not of the aspect of [the concept of] three lines, but rather they are three complete partzufim enclothed within one another. ‎ Ḥokhma , which is the ** mem ** of ** tzelem ,** is the mystical meaning of [ Abba and Imma Ila’in ] which are enclothed from the chest and below inside the [lower aspect of] Bina , which is Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna and the ** lamed ** of ** tzelem .** The Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna are enclothed from the chest and below inside the Da’at , which is ‎ Ze’er Anpin , ‎the ** tzadi ** of ** tzelem . ‎**

[The Zohar ] thus states: **“And to complete oneself in the lofty form, as it is stated: And God created man in His own image.”** By virtue of the ** tefillin ,** ‎brains ‎of the first three [ sefirot ] are drawn forth in the order of the letters ** tzadi-lamed-mem ,** which appear in the verse: “And God ‎created man in His own image.” This is the mystical meaning of **the supernal brightness** of ‎ Atzilut that Adam the first [man] ‎received when he was created. We draw the [letters] first to [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba , from where these ‎brains ‎transmit to us [below] as well. ‎ The order of the letters ** tzadi-lamed-mem ** is clarified in the four chapters of the ** Tefillin ,** as set out below.

[The Zohar ] continues: **“The tefillin of the head, the name of the supernal, holy ‎King, Havaya , in inscribed letters.”** The tefillin are called **Carmel,** because **Carmel** means ** car malei ** [a pasture filled] with all goodness. This is the mystical meaning of the verse: **“Your head upon you is like Carmel.”** That is, when the supernal head of ‎ Ze’er Anpin , as well as ‎that of the ‎ Nukba , are enclothed in **the tefillin of the head,** which are the supernal ‎brains of ** tzelem ,** they are **like** ‎**Carmel, like a pasture filled** with all goodness. These ‎brains are called **“the name of the supernal, ‎holy King,”** namely, the four letters of ** Havaya ,** in accordance with the order of the letters: ** Yod , heh , vav , heh . ‎** The reason why [the Zohar ] emphasizes **“ Havaya in inscribed letters”** is that each and every letter is inscribed in ‎a separate ‎ partzuf , since there are the four letters of ** Havaya ** which are ten ‎ sefirot in every ‎ partzuf . [The Zohar ] therefore specifies that the reference [here] is to **inscribed letters,** namely, that each [letter] is [also] a complete ‎ partzuf in itself. ‎

[The Zohar ] continues: **“Each and every letter** of the name Havaya **is one chapter** of the four chapters in ‎ tefillin . **The holy name is inscribed** in them, **in** accordance with **the order of the ‎letters, as is fitting.”** A “chapter” means a complete ‎ partzuf in and ‎of itself. [The Zohar ] is saying that each and every letter of the name ** Havaya ** becomes, in the mystical meaning of the ‎brains, a complete, distinct ‎ partzuf . They are arranged in the [ tefillin ] boxes **“in the order of the ‎letters, as is fitting,”** that is, in the order ** yod , heh , vav , heh .** This is the mystical meaning of **the tefillin of Rashi,** since **the tefillin of Rabbeinu Tam** are arranged in the boxes in the order of the acronym from the verse: “But let he who glories glory in this, that he understands and knows [** y ** ithalel **h**amithalel **h**askel **v**e-yado’a ] Me” [Jeremiah 9:23], namely, ** yod , heh , heh , vav ,** as is known. ‎

**238. “The first chapter is Sanctify, etc.” The first chapter** in the tefillin **is “Sanctify to Me every firstborn.” This is** [the letter] ** yod ** of ‎ Havaya , **which is “sanctify,”** namely, Ḥokhma , the **firstborn of all the lofty, sanctified ones.** It is **“who opens every womb”** [Exodus 13:2], **through that delicate trail that descends from** the ** yod , which opens the ‎womb to bear fruits and offspring, as is fitting. This is the lofty, sanctified one. ‎**

Explanation: This is referring to Abba and Imma Ila’in , who are alluded to in the letter ** yod ** of the name ** Havaya ,** as the ** yod ** alludes to Abba , and the filling in [of the other letters] of [the spelled-out] yod , ‎which are vav-dalet , alludes to Imma . The partzuf of [ Abba and Imma Ila’in ] is called **“sanctify,”** and it is [also] termed **“firstborn”** because no partzuf from Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna and [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba of Atzilut are called **“sanctify”** unless they receive the sanctity from Abba and Imma Ila’in . ‎

[The Zohar ] continues: **“Firstborn of all the lofty sanctified ones,”** namely, [ Abba and Imma Ila’in are] **the firstborn** ‎of all the holy partzufim of Atzilut , for the sanctity of the partzufim of Atzilut is drawn from [ Abba and Imma Ila’in ]. The reason is that the light of Ḥokhma is called “sanctify,” and, as has already been explained, [ Abba and Imma Ila’in ] are [the letter] ** mem ** of ** tzelem .** They are Ḥokhma ‎ of Atzilut because the sealed Ḥokhma [from Arikh Anpin ]‎ is enclothed and concealed in [ Abba and Imma Ila’in ].

Despite this [lofty status in Atzilut ], [ Abba and Imma Ila’in ] themselves are considered only “pure air,” namely, the light of giving, since this [sealed] Ḥokhma ‎ was sealed [away] in the head of Arikh Anpin . ‎ The partzufim [of Atzilut ] can receive Ḥokhma ‎ only from Bina [when Bina ] returns to be Ḥokhma [which transpires]‎ when [ Bina ] ‎ascends to the head of Arikh Anpin and unites there with the sealed Ḥokhma ‎, by means of [ Abba and Imma Ila’in ]. Then the Bina is also called Ḥokhma ‎, and this Ḥokhma ‎ is called Ḥokhma ‎ of the thirty-two paths. Thus, even the Bina that returns ‎to being Ḥokhma ‎ is called **“sanctify”** only because [ Bina ] receives from the sealed Ḥokhma that is in Abba and Imma Ila’in as a result of the ‎ascent [of Bina ] to Arikh Anpin . This is all the more the case [with respect to] the rest of the partzufim of Atzilut , which receive only ‎from this Bina that returned to be Ḥokhma ‎. ‎ This will be clarified further below.

[The Zohar ] states that “with **that delicate trail that descends from** the ** yod , which opens the ‎womb to bear fruits and offspring.”** The meaning is as follows: There are three components to the ** yod : Head, torso, and trail.** Its upper tip is called **head,** which alludes to the expression of Arikh Anpin that ‎is hidden and enclothed in [ Abba and Imma Ila’in ] (as mentioned in the preceding section). The body of the ** yod ** is called **“torso,”** which alludes to the partzuf of ‎[ Abba and Imma Ila’in ] themselves. [Finally, ] the bottom tip of the ** yod ** is called **“trail,”** alluding to the [bottom] foundations of [ Abba and Imma Ila’in ] at the endpoint of their partzuf , and this is called **“a delicate trail.”‎**

However, the name **“trail”** refers primarily to Yesod of the ‎ Abba [component of Abba and Imma Ila’in ], since Yesod of ‎the Imma [component] is called **‎‎“path,”** in the mystical meaning of “this trail is positioned on this path,” and in the mystical meaning of the verse: “And Your path in the mighty waters” [Psalms 77:20]. The [lights of the light of giving], when the ‎ shefa in them is great, are called “mighty waters,” since by means of this pairing of ‎**trail and path,** which is a fusion that never stops, mighty waters are ceaselessly transmitted to the worlds. Before the ‎ partzuf of Abba and Imma as established with the connection of **trail and path,** no shefa was transmitted to ‎the worlds. ‎

[The Zohar ] continues: **“Who opens every womb, through that delicate trail that descends from** the ** yod .”** The path of ‎the Imma [component of Abba and Imma ] is called **“a womb,”** because all the [aspects of] mercy are given from there. Before [ Abba and Imma Ila’in ] were established in the joining of trail and path, there was a blockage, and it opened only through **the ‎delicate trail** of the ‎ Abba [component]. Accordingly, the delicate trail is called **“‘who opens** [ petter ] **every womb, ’ which opens the ‎womb to bear fruits and offspring,”** for ** petter ** means “opens.” When the delicate trail of ‎the Abba [component] connected to [the Imma ], ‎ Imma gives **fruits and offspring** in great abundance, **“as is fitting,”** in the mystical meaning of the verse: “And Your path in the mighty waters.”
