**239. “The second chapter is, and it shall be, etc.” The second chapter is: “And it shall be when** [the Lord] **shall bring you”** [Exodus 13:5]. **It is** [the letter] ** heh ** of ‎ Havaya , which is Bina . This is the **palace whose womb opens by means of the yod in fifty hidden openings, ‎corridors, and rooms that are within it.** [The purpose of] **that opening, which the yod made in this palace, is in order to hear in it the ‎sound that emerges from this shofar ,** which is Bina . **This shofar is sealed on ‎all sides, and the yod comes and opens it, to produce the sound from it. Once she opens it, ‎she blows it and produces a sound from it, to deliver slaves to freedom. ‎**

Explanation: The ** heh ** of the name ** Havaya ** alludes to the partzuf of Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , which is the mystical meaning of [the letter] ** lamed ** of ** tzelem ,** called “a ‎tower that flies in the air.” This is “the **palace, whose [womb] opens... in fifty [hidden] ‎openings.”** [ Abba and Imma Ila’in ] are considered sealed air that does not open, in the mystical meaning of the ** mem ** of ** tzelem ,** which alludes to a ring that surrounds their ‎brains. The ** yod ** does not emerge from their avir [air] in such a way that [ Abba and Imma Ila’in ] would transmit the light of Ḥokhma . Therefore, they give out only pure air, which [means] the light of giving, as stated above. In contrast, Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , which is the mystical meaning of ** lamed ** of ** tzelem ** and an aspect of Bina , are considered a **“palace, whose [womb] opens... in fifty [hidden] ‎openings,”** transmitting ‎ Ḥokhma to [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba through the ascent [of Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna ] to the head of Arikh Anpin , where the Bina is transformed into Ḥokhma , as stated. ‎

This Bina is called **“fifty** gates of Bina ,” because it contains the five sefirot : Keter , Ḥokhma , and Bina , [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba , in each of which there are ten ‎ sefirot , which makes fifty. Each of the fifty sefirot divides into **rooms and corridors.** The aspect of Ḥesed , Gevura , and Tiferet in a sefira are ‎called **“rooms,”** and the aspect of Netzaḥ , Hod , and Yesod in [a sefira ] are called **“corridors,”** indicating that this [aspect of Netzaḥ , Hod , and Yesod ] is not a vessel of receiving for itself, but rather only [serves as] the aspect of exiting and entering the rooms (as stated in section #229#, above).

[The Zohar ] thus states: **“And it shall be when** [the Lord] **shall bring you” is** [the letter] ** heh ,** [the] **palace whose womb opens.”** The second chapter of the tefillin , which is **“And it shall be when** [the Lord] **shall bring you,”** alludes to the ** heh ** of ‎the name ** Havaya ,** which is the partzuf of Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna of Atzilut , **whose womb** opens to transmit Ḥokhma to [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba , as stated. The phrase **“by means of the yod ”** will be explained presently.

This is the meaning of **“in order to hear in it the ‎sound** etc.” [This is referring to] that opening which the ** yod ** made in that palace, in order to hear through [the opening] the sound that emerges from this shofar , because this shofar is sealed on all sides. Explanation: As has already been explained above, when Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , which is ‎ Bina , partnered with Malkhut , the three sefirot [represented by the letters of] ** eleh ** [ alef - lamed-heh ], which are ‎ Bina , and [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba , of the body of ‎ Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , descended to [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba of Atzilut , such that only the two letters ** mi ** [ mem-yod ] remained in Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna . ‎Subsequently, by raising feminine waters, the bottom heh [which is the Malkhut that ascended to partner with Bina ] once again descended from the apertures of the eyes [which is Bina of the head] to the place of the mouth [which is Malkhut of the head], as [the Malkhut ] was ‎before the partnership. Then the three letters ** alef - lamed-heh ** [ eleh ] ascend back to [ Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna ], and the name ‎** Elohim is completed** again (as stated in section #14# above; see there in detail). ‎

Together with these ** alef - lamed-heh ** that ascend back to the ‎ Bina , the [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba also ascend (as stated above, in section #17#, 3rd paragraph; see there in detail). It has also been explained (section #14# above, 5th paragraph) that although the three letters ** alef - lamed-heh ** have already‎ ascended and connected to the ‎ Bina , **and the name Elohim has been completed,** it is still considered that ‎the name Elokim **is deep and sealed in the name** [section #14#]. This is because there is only light of Ḥokhma there, and the illumination ‎of Ḥokhma cannot be received in ** alef - lamed-heh ** except through the enclothing of the light of giving; see there in detail. Therefore, it is ‎considered that these letters ** alef - lamed-heh ** are the aspect of ** shofar ,** in which there are enclothed the [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba that ascended with ‎them to the ‎ Bina , which are considered [the aspect of] the voice [of the shofar]. The reason [for this ascent and enclothing of Ze’er Anpin and Nukba ] is that [the alef-lamed-heh ] are the ones that raise the [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba with them to ‎ Bina , by virtue of the fact that [the Ze’er Anpin and Nukba ] are incorporated in [the alef-lamed-heh ] in the phase of immaturity. Thus [the alef-lamed-heh ] carry the ‎ Ze’er Anpin within them, as stated there.

[The Zohar ] continues: **“That opening, which the yod made in this palace, in order to hear in it the ‎sound that emerges from this shofar .”** The ** yod ,** which is Abba and Imma Ila’in , are the ones who transmit supernal illumination to lower the bottom heh [which is Malkhut ] ‎from the apertures of the eyes [which is Bina ] of Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna back to the mouth [of Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna . This [process] also raises the three letters ** alef - lamed-heh ** that were in the level of the [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba , ‎reconnecting them to the ‎ Bina , as they were before the partnering with the Malkhut . Thus, [this illustrates that] the ** yod ** opened the palace of Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna in order to bestow ‎brains to ‎ Ze’er Anpin from **the shofar , ‎**which are the letters ** alef - lamed-heh ** that were raised. [This bestowal of brains to Ze’er Anpin and Nukba happens] because the [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba also ascend‎ with the letters ** alef - lamed-heh ** to the ‎ Bina , where they receive [the brains of the light of] ‎ Ḥokhma . ‎

This is the meaning of **“in order to hear in it the ‎sound,”** namely, to emanate the ‎ Ze’er Anpin with the ‎‎brains of maturity, called a **“sound,”** and whose emanation is considered as the making of **a sound. “For this shofar is sealed on ‎all sides,”** that is, from both the light of giving and [the light of] Ḥokhma . [This is] because the letters ** alef - lamed-heh ,** ‎which are called ** shofar ,** fall [down to] the place of [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba and there they are sealed off from both the [light of the] first three [ sefirot ] and the light of giving. Therefore, they require two rectifications: 1) To be elevated and connected to ‎ Bina , so that they attain ‎the aspect of their first three [ sefirot ], which is the light of Ḥokhma ; 2) to transmit the light of giving to them which will serve as an enclothing for [the light of] ‎ Ḥokhma . ‎

[The Zohar ] continues: **“And the yod comes and opens it, to produce the sound from it.”** This is the first rectification, that the yod ‎draws forth the supernal illumination to the heh , which is the palace of Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna . This lowers the bottom ‎ heh [which is Malkhut ] to its place and raises the three letters ** alef - lamed-heh ** with the [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba that is within them and connects them to the ‎ Bina . The [letters] thereby attain the illumination of ‎ Ḥokhma , which also serves as ‎brains for the ‎ Ze’er Anpin that ascended with the letters ‎ ** alef - lamed-heh .** However, the illumination of ‎ Ḥokhma remains sealed and does not illuminate, due to absence ‎of the light of giving, as stated. Therefore, it is considered that the **sound** has not yet emerged, meaning that the ‎ Ze’er Anpin has not ‎been born. This is the meaning of **“to** subsequently **produce the sound from it,”** by means of the second rectification. Now, however, [before the second rectification, ] it has not yet emerged. ‎

**“Once she** then **opens it, ‎she blows it and produces a sound from it, to deliver slaves to freedom.”** ‎This is the aforementioned second rectification. After opening the palace, namely, connecting the letters ** alef - lamed-heh ** ‎with [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba back to ‎ Bina , where they attain the light of ‎ Ḥokhma , she **“blows it,”** namely, the ‎** yod ** blows air into the ** shofar ,** as “air [ avir ]” means the light of giving. Since the ** shofar ,** which is the letters ‎** alef - lamed-heh **, also received avir , meaning the light of giving, it **“produces a sound from it”** meaning it gives birth to the ‎ Ze’er Anpin , which is called a **"sound”** and brings the completed [ Ze’er Anpin ] to its place. By means of the enclothing of the light of giving which the ** yod ** blew, the ‎[light of] Ḥokhma could be enclothed ‎in that [light of giving] and be received into the ‎ Ze’er Anpin . Hence, these brains that the ‎ Ze’er Anpin attained, called **“sound,”** delivers slaves ‎to freedom. In other words, the ‎ Ze’er Anpin transmits its illumination to the worlds [below], and then the children of Israel merit the brains of the first three [ sefirot ], which are called “freedom.”‎

**240. “And with the blowing of this shofar, etc.” And with the blowing of this shofar , Israel came out of Egypt. So it will be in the future,** that the shofar will be blown **on a different occasion, at ‎the end of days. Every redemption comes from this shofar ,** which is Bina . **For this reason it is in this chapter, the exodus from Egypt, since it came from this shofar , through the strength of the yod that opened ‎her womb and produced its sound for the redemption of the slaves. This is heh , the ‎second letter of the holy name. ‎**

Explanation: All the brains that are transmitted to [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba come from **this shofar ,** namely the aforementioned ‎letters ** alef - lamed-heh .** Those great brains that ‎ Ze’er Anpin received to bring Israel out of Egypt, were also from ‎**this shofar ** in the same manner, and the brains that will be revealed at the end of days for the complete redemption will likewise be from **this shofar ** in the same manner.

**“For this reason it is in this chapter, the exodus from Egypt,”** namely, the chapter: **“And it shall be when** [the Lord] **shall bring you”** [Exodus 13:5], in the tefillin . **“Since it came from this shofar ”:** The brains that were revealed for the exodus from Egypt came from this ** shofar ** that is in Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna . That is, **“through the strength of the yod that opened ‎her womb,”** by means of the power of ‎[ Abba and Imma Ila’in ], called the ** yod ** of Havaya . This [power] opened the womb of Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , which are the letters ** alef - lamed-heh ** that were discussed above.

**“And produced its sound:”** This is ‎ Ze’er Anpin , called **“sound,”** through the attainment of these brains **“for the redemption of the slaves,”** ‎which suffice to bring Israel out from enslavement to freedom. Know that ‎ Ze’er Anpin and ‎ Nukba are called **‎‎“sound” and “speech”** only upon the attainment of brains of ḥaya , but not at the other levels below the level of ḥaya . All the redemptions come from the ‎brains of ḥaya , as explained. ‎

**241. “The third chapter is the secret, etc.” The third chapter is the secret of the unification of “Hear O Israel”** [Deuteronomy 6:4]. **It is** [the letter] ** vav ** of Havaya , **‎incorporating everything,** which is Ze’er Anpin , **and in whom there is the unification of everything, for they ‎unite in him and he takes everything. The fourth chapter is: “And it shall come to pass, if ‎you listen”** [Deuteronomy 11:13], **which incorporates the two sides,** Ḥesed and Gevura , **in which the Assembly of Israel, which is the Gevura ‎below,** which is Malkhut , **unites through them. This is the last heh ** of Havaya , **which takes them and is incorporated ‎from them. ‎**

Explanation: The third chapter in tefillin , **“Hear O Israel,”** is the partzuf Ze’er Anpin , called ** vav ** of Havaya , **“incorporating everything,”** since it includes all these four ‎chapters in the tefillin . Although the first two chapters, **“Sanctify”** and ‎‎**“And it shall be when** [the Lord] **shall bring you,”** are [ Abba and Imma Ila’in ] and Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , called Ḥokhma and Bina , this does not mean that they themselves are [ Abba and Imma Ila’in ] ‎and Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna . Rather, they are [the aspects of Abba and Imma Ila’in ] and Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna that are enclothed in the head of [‎ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba , in the mystical meaning of Ḥokhma and Bina in the brains of Ze’er Anpin , which are called ** mem-lamed ** of tzelem of Ze’er Anpin . ‎

Likewise, regarding the fourth chapter, **“And it shall come to pass, if you listen,”** [the Zohar ] says below that this is the Nukba of Ze’er Anpin , this does ‎not mean the Nukba itself, but only the aspect of the Nukba that is incorporated in Ze’er Anpin . [This aspect] in [ Ze’er Anpin ] is called by the name ‎‎“the brain of the Gevura ” of Ze’er Anpin . There are three brains in Ze’er Anpin , called Ḥokhma , Bina , and Da’at , and these are called ** mem-lamed-tzadi ** of tzelem of Ze’er Anpin . These are Ḥokhma , Bina , Tiferet , and Malkhut that are in the brains of Ze’er Anpin . In Da’at , which is ** tzadi ,** ‎there are [the sefirot of] Ḥesed and Gevura ; the Ḥesed in Da’at is regarded as the aspect of Ze’er Anpin itself, while the Gevura in Da’at is regarded ‎as an integration of the Nukba . These are the four chapters in the Tefillin . ‎

Thus, Ze’er Anpin , which is ** vav ** of Havaya , **incorporates everything,** all four chapters. **“In whom there is the unification of everything,”** for all the unifications that are applied to [ Abba and Imma Ila’in ] and Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna are only in Ze’er Anpin , namely, solely for the needs ‎of Ze’er Anpin . [In fact, ] the partzufim [of Abba and Imma Ila’in and Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna ] that precede Ze’er Anpin are always in a state of unification and do not require feminine waters from ‎the lower [beings] in order to unify them. All the unifications that we perform in the higher partzufim ‎through feminine waters are not for themselves at all, but only for the sake of Ze’er Anpin .

**“For they ‎unite in him.”** There is no unification of Ḥokhma and Bina for the [sake of the] lower ones, in which Bina returns to be Ḥokhma , except ‎through the ascent of Ze’er Anpin to them as feminine waters. In the phase when the Ze’er Anpin ascends to the Bina as feminine waters, the Bina then ascends to the head ‎of Arikh Anpin and receives Ḥokhma to transmit to Ze’er Anpin , but not for [ Bina ] itself. [This is because] the nature [of Bina ] in its ten ‎ sefirot of direct light, is only the light of giving, in the mystical meaning of the verse: because He delights in ḥesed ” [“mercy”; Micah 7:18]. ‎[The Bina ] has no [inherent] reason to ascend to the head ‎of Arikh Anpin to fuse with Ḥokhma there. Rather, the Ze’er Anpin that ascends to the Bina awakens [the Bina ] to transmit Ḥokhma on behalf [of Ze’er Anpin ]. ‎

Thus, the Bina unifies with the Ḥokhma only because of Ze’er Anpin and for the sake of Ze’er Anpin . This is the meaning of the phrase: **“For they ‎unite in him and he,** Ze’er Anpin , **takes everything.”** Even the light of the Ḥokhma that the Bina takes on behalf of Ze’er Anpin is not revealed in the ‎level of the Bina at all, but only in the level of Ze’er Anpin , from the chest [of Arikh Anpin ] and below, as stated in the appropriate place. Accordingly, Ze’er Anpin takes all these ‎brains, not those who are above him. ‎

[The Zohar ] continues: **“And it shall come to pass, if ‎you listen” which incorporates the two sides in which the Assembly of Israel, the Gevura of ‎below, unites.”** The chapter **“Hear”** is the mystical meaning of Ze’er Anpin , ** vav ** of Havaya , which is the mystical meaning of the **supernal ‎unification** (mentioned in section #207# above, with regard to the third commandment) in which the secret of the love is revealed only on the side of mercy (as stated in section #205#; see there). This is the chapter: “And you shall ‎love” [Deuteronomy 6:5], a chapter that is all love without any aspect of judgment in it at all. ‎

However, the fourth chapter, **“And it shall come to pass, if you listen,”** is an aspect of **the lower heh ** of ‎ Havaya , which is the Nukba of Ze’er Anpin that is incorporated in [ Ze’er Anpin ], as stated previously, [and] which is Gevura in the Da’at of Ze’er Anpin . Through this [ Nukba ], the love is revealed on two ‎sides: **Both on the side of mercy and on the side of harsh judgment** (as stated in section #206#, 4th paragraph; see there in detail). Consequently, the chapter **“And it shall come to pass, if you listen”** contains **love both on the side of mercy,** until the verse **“take heed to yourselves”** [Deuteronomy 11:13], **and on the side of harsh judgment,** from “take heed to yourselves” and onwards.

This is the meaning of the statement: **“And it shall come to pass, if ‎you listen, which incorporates the two sides,”** for it has both the side of mercy and the side of harsh judgment, [the two sides] **“in which the Assembly of Israel** […] **unites.”** This is **the lower unification of “Blessed be the name of the glory of His kingdom forever and ever,”** through which the Nukba of Ze’er Anpin , called ‎‎“the Assembly of Israel,” unites (as stated in the aforementioned source, section #206#, 4th paragraph).

**“The Gevura ‎below.”** In other words, this is not the actual Nukba herself, but the Gevura below, in the brain of the Da’at , as explained above. It is **“the last heh ** of Havaya , **which takes them and is incorporated ‎from them,”** because the Gevura in Da’at , is the lower ** heh ** of the name Havaya , which takes all the brains in **the upper unification of “Hear O Israel,”** and is incorporated from ‎them. It is only through [that lower heh ] that the brains are completed, since there is room in it to ‎reveal **the love on both sides,** because the [side of the love that is] harsh judgment that completes the love is not located above [that heh ], as stated. ‎

**“Therefore,** it is stated: **‘Your head upon you is like Carmel’** [Song of Songs 7:6]. **This is** an allusion to **the tefillin of the head”** [see next section]. After the Ze’er Anpin ‎is enclothed in all four brains that are alluded to in the four chapters, which are the three letters ** tzadi-lamed-mem ** [ tzelem ], as stated, the head [of Ze’er Anpin ] is considered like **Carmel,** which is an abbreviated form of ** car malei ** [a pasture filled] with all goodness [see section #237#, above]. ‎

**242. “The Tefillin are the letters of the holy name, etc.” The tefillin are the letters of the holy name. Therefore, it is stated: “Your head upon you ‎is like the Carmel.” This is** an allusion to **the tefillin of the head. “And the hair** [ dalat ] **of your head”** [Song of Songs 7:6] **is that tefillin of the hand, ‎** which is Malkhut , **who is a pauper** [ dal means “poor”] **facing upward,** Ze’er Anpin . **She also has a completeness similar to above. ‎**

Explanation: The Malkhut is the mystical meaning of the tefillin of the hand, and [this Malkhut ] is **“a pauper facing upward,”** [relative to] the world above. The higher world, Bina , partners with [the Malkhut ] (as stated above with regard to the ninth commandment), in order to complete [the Malkhut ], [such that **“She, too, has a completeness similar to above,”** as now [that Malkhut ] receives the complete wholeness of the higher world, ‎ Bina . This occurs through the lower unification of “Blessed be the name of the glory of His kingdom forever and ever,” as clarified above in the fourth chapter [about] Ze’er Anpin . Since [this Malkhut ] is not the Nukba in the body of Ze’er Anpin , but the ‎separated Nukba of Ze’er Anpin , [this separated Malkhut ] thus takes all four chapters from [ Ze’er Anpin ], which are Ḥokhma and Bina , Ḥesed and Gevura of Ze’er Anpin , because [this Malkhut ] is ‎a separate and complete partzuf . However, these [chapters] are in a single container rather than in four separate containers ‎like in the tefillin of Ze’er Anpin . ‎

The reason is that a chapter is the mystical meaning of the light, while its box is the mystical meaning of the vessel. It is known that from every [fusion through collision] a light and vessel are drawn forth. Consequently, ‎the Ze’er Anpin , whose four chapters – which are his four brains: Ḥokhma and Bina , Ḥesed and Gevura – are drawn to him in four ‎fusions, likewise has four boxes [which are vessels], a specific box for each chapter. By contrast, [in the case of] the Nukba , ‎there is no fusion in [this Nukba ] itself. Rather [the Nukba ] receives all four brains, which are the four chapters, ‎in a single fusion from Ze’er Anpin , and therefore it has only one box for all four chapters. ‎
